text:
Noah: opened a docs PR that updates SOC2 wording on audit-log retention and adds two new safe SDK snippets (Rust + Ruby). Asking for legal + intl review and a quick link anchor check.

Ivy: Nice. Two quick asks: (1) redact any example emails/usernames, (2) mention page_size/cursor in samples to prevent full scans.

Noah: Yep — replaced PII with <redacted_email> and added page_size to examples. Draft retention blurb I added: "By default, Hosted audit logs are retained for 365 days; customers can request different retention through their account team. Dedicated/Private retention is contractual." Need legal confirmation on Hosted vs Dedicated wording.

Rach: For the Rust snippet can we show streaming + redaction? Short example:
```rust
// Rust - stream audit events and redact before logging
let mut stream = client.audit().stream("since=2024-01-01", Some(100));
while let Some(ev) = stream.next().await {
    let mut safe = ev.clone();
    safe.user_email = "<redacted>".to_string();
    tracing::info!(event = ?safe.event_type);
}
```
Note: made up API call shapes for readability.

Ivy: Good. For Ruby please show pagination with cursor and a one-line note about not storing raw exports:
```ruby
# Ruby - paginated listing and redact
cursor = nil
loop do
  res = client.audit.list(since: '2024-01-01', page_size: 200, cursor: cursor)
  res.items.each do |e|
    e['user_email'] = '<redacted>'
    puts e['event_type']
  end
  break unless res.next_cursor
  cursor = res.next_cursor
end
```
Add: "Do not persist raw audit events with PII to long-term logs."

Raj: Legal review: prefer wording tweak: "Hosted customers: audit logs are retained, by default, for 365 days. Dedicated and Private deployments have configurable retention per contract; contact your account team. Logs are encrypted at rest; Private deployments may use customer-managed keys where applicable. Access to audit logs is restricted via RBAC and recorded in access audit trails." Also: do not publish retention numbers for Dedicated/Private.

Noah: Updated PR with Raj's phrasing and scoping. Also added a small callout about redaction best-practices and a link to /docs/security/audit-logs#retention-policy. Can LegalBot add reviewer?

LegalBot: automated: Flagged for legal review. @Raj added. Also flagged for localization review due to jurisdictional wording (EU pages).

IntlTeam: Reviewing localization: suggestion to avoid country-specific guarantees. Suggest adding "Policies may vary by region and deployment." We'll add a small localized note on EU pages if needed.

Rach: Small docs nit: the anchor in the existing page changed to `#retention-policy` last sprint; PR linked to `#retention`  I pushed a fix to the link and removed an obsolete example `max_days` field from YAML.

Ivy: Also added a one-line developer warning above the snippets: "These examples are illustrative and redact PII; do not copy tokens or real user identifiers into public docs."

Raj: Approved (legal) pending one micro-edit: replace "may use" with "can use" in the customer-managed keys sentence for clarity. No other holds.

Noah: Accepted Raj's suggestion and pushed. Anything else before merge?

IntlTeam: LGTM on localization pending minor translation checks.

Ivy: All green from docs side. I'll merge after translations finish.

Noah: Thanks everyone  merging after Intl check. Will open a follow-up to add the Rust/Ruby examples to the internal snippet repo. :tada:
